title: ArsonVille
description:
You have only one chance to start the fire. Make it count.

In ArsonVille, your goal is to place combustible objects throughout a peaceful village before igniting a single flame. Once the fire begins, there is no turning back. Watch it spread across the map, burn houses, consume trees, and see how much of the village you can destroy.

Every playthrough offers a new challenge thanks to procedurally generated maps, giving you endless opportunities to experiment with different strategies and fire paths.

Features

• Plan your setup before lighting a single fire.

• Burn houses, trees, and everything the flames can reach.

• Procedurally generated maps for endless replayability.

• Casual gameplay focused on experimentation and destruction.
description_short: A calming, relaxing, yet slightly disturbing casual game in which you attempt to completely burn down a village.
